Account Deactivation and Unresolved Complaints
I am writing to tell you about my deep dissatisfaction with the service I have received from Myntra and to formally escalate the issues surrounding the sudden deactivation of my account without any explanation. On October 2nd, I raised a complaint regarding a perfume order that arrived with an empty box. I was assured a resolution by October 5th; however, my complaint was marked as resolved despite not receiving any resolution. When I re-raised the issue on October 5th, I was assured again that it would be resolved by October 9th, but unfortunately, no action has been taken. On october 10th, I logged into my account only to find that it has been deactivated without any explanation. As a loyal and Elite customer, I frequently shop on your platform, and I currently have Rs 4000 in Myntra credits (from a gift card) at stake. This sudden deactivation not only jeopardizes my funds but also disrupts my ongoing orders and wishlist items. I’ve reached out to the customer care multiple times through calls and emails (customer grievances, support, communication) but haven’t received response from anywhere. My continued patronage of Myntra is contingent upon a satisfactory resolution of these issues. I won’t recommend this app to people.I believe it is crucial for potential customers to be aware of the service shortcomings I have encountered.

Use Myntra app❤️❤️❤️❤️
I’ve been using the Myntra app for over 2 years now and it has genuinely become my go-to fashion app. The interface is super smooth, clean, and incredibly easy to navigate — even my mom who isn’t very tech-savvy finds it simple to use.
What I love the most:
• Huge collection of original brands and trendy styles. From casual wear to ethnic, sportswear to party dresses — everything is available.
• The filters are actually useful! Size, color, brand, price, discount % — I can find exactly what I want in seconds.
• Lightning-fast search and excellent recommendations. It really understands my taste now.
• Great offers and bank discounts almost every week. I’ve saved so much money during their End of Reason Sale and Big Billion Days.
• Super convenient COD + easy returns. Return pickup is hassle-free and refunds are quick.
• Quality of images and product descriptions are top-notch. What you see is almost always what you get.
• Wishlist and “Save for later” features are perfect for tracking favorite items.
Delivery is usually on time (often earlier than promised), and the packaging is neat. Customer support is responsive too.
If you love fashion and want a premium yet affordable shopping experience, just download the Myntra app. You won’t regret it! 💖
Highly recommended! 5/5 🔥

‘Wishlist’ option box
Most of the navigations and functions on the app are good. What I really miss is the ‘Wishlist’ option in the first 4 boxes. Like most of my friends and colleagues, I usually don’t use the ‘insider’ or ‘coupons’ option frequently. Even ‘help centre’ is rarely used. Most of these offers are valid on items that we don’t buy or use. 
But I really miss the ‘Wishlist’ option in the first screen before the break. It should, ideally, be next to the ‘orders’ option as many times you keep the items in your Wishlist and then keep visiting it frequently while placing order. Even after scrolling, it is not highlighted and it become frustrating to look for it. 
In the desktop version, it is nicely placed under the ‘orders’ which according to me is the best placement.

Fashion at Your Fingertips – Myntra Review
Myntra is one of India’s leading online fashion and lifestyle platforms, offering a wide variety of clothing, footwear, accessories, and beauty products for men, women, and kids. It stands out for its trendy collections, user-friendly app, and smooth shopping experience.

The platform regularly offers exciting deals, discounts, and seasonal sales, making branded fashion more affordable. Product filters, size guides, and customer reviews make it easier to find the right items. Delivery is generally fast, and the packaging is neat and professional.

Myntra’s return and exchange policy is hassle-free, with doorstep pickup and quick refunds. The app also features a wishlist, style recommendations, and personalized feeds to enhance the shopping journey.

However, during sale periods, users may experience delayed deliveries or out-of-stock issues. Still, Myntra’s customer service usually resolves concerns promptly.

In summary, Myntra is a go-to destination for fashion lovers looking for variety, quality, and convenience—all in one place.

Wrong pricing and no support from customer care
I recently had a disappointing experience with Myntra. I had added Adidas SL72 shoes (size 8) to my wishlist, where the price was clearly showing as ₹5,499. But the moment I tried adding them to my cart, the price jumped to ₹6,999.

I called customer care to clarify, and they asked me to send screenshots over email and told me it would take 24 hours to review. When I asked if I could still purchase the product at the wishlist price of ₹5,499, the response was “No, it depends on the current product price at the time of purchase.”

This makes no sense — if the app shows a lower price in the wishlist, why can’t customers buy it at that rate? There’s no proper resolution offered, which leaves customers frustrated and confused. Myntra should fix this glitch or at least honor the price shown in the wishlist.

I LOVE THIS APP! I was a bit apprehensive initially because of all the negative reviews I’ve read but honestly, personally, I have nothing to say other than good things! The catalogue is trendy and different to what is offered by other sites, the prices are reasonable and the delivery time is quicker than expected! That being said, I do wish some improvements can be made to the app in general. For example, the limit for how many items we can wishlist/add to bag at one time is unnecessarily stringent. Also, when you move from this app to another, it reboots - meaning you lose all the progress you made in terms of navigation. Although, while not necessarily a problem, AJIO would benefit greatly by adding a proper makeup category! Because at the moment one has to switch to another app for makeup. Once these issues are resolved I think AJIO will very well become my go-to fashion shopping app!

Unreliable and Cheats
Been using this app for a few years now so I’m pretty qualified to have an opinion on it. Earlier it was a great app even though it has crashing issues on ios since inception and even the latest version seems to be having the same issues. Looking beyond that, I had a very good experience with Ajio for a fairly long time but in the last year or so it’s the complete opposite! I’ve ordered a lot of things from sneakers to jeans etc. got good discounts. However, now it seems the prices are inflated and the so-called sale is just a farce. First of all the products will be sold out (within a minute, really?!) and even if you are able to add to cart and buy, Ajio will arbitrarily cancel the order and give no reason or compensation for the cancellation, it’s not a once off thing for them. I have decided I’ll pay a little bit extra but buy elsewhere till they sort their business and attitude out. Can not in good conscience recommend this app to anyone till then.

2. App rebooting if switches between other apps frequently. It’s annoying since user view is vanishing and starting from beginning.
3. Limiting the wish list.
Overall experience good. If AJIO address the above asap then user experience will be great enough.

Privacy concerns
I added some products to cart but did not log in. And the next time I opened the app they were all gone. The app just looks like a web wrapper, please implement some local storage. I spent a lot of time shortlisting the products.

Also, I got a text message on my number, saying welcome to AJIO. I did not sign-up at all, let alone sign-up for any text alerts. Seems like the app can already read your mobile number, sent it to their servers and knew I did not have an account. I checked the app description and it says "Contact Info" in both "Data Linked To You" and "Data Not Linked To You". Both of these things are concerning.

App Freezes and Wish List is Unresponsive
I’ve been experiencing constant issues with this app even after updating it several times. The app frequently gets stuck, and it’s really frustrating. I’m unable to access my wish list at all—whenever I try to open it, nothing shows up, and it freezes. Additionally, whenever I try to click on certain items to view more details, they remain invisible or unresponsive. I’ve tried restarting my device, reinstalling the app, and checking my internet connection, but the issues persist. Hoping for a fix soon, as this app used to work well for me!

App & Website Super Slow!
Nykaa Fashion has such a great curation of brands, but I find it extremely difficult to enjoy a good shopping experience simply because both, the app and the website, are ridiculously slow to navigate. Online shopping is supposed to be a fun and quick way to get your shopping done. But even the simplest tasks take forever - adding an item to the cart, adding an item to wish list, moving an item from wish list to cart or vice versa. Not once has it happened instantly. Every time it shows the loading symbol with the Nykaa logo animation. It is genuinely frustrating to spend triple the amount of time to navigate and sort your cart. There are so many times I don’t end up using Nykaa Fashion simply because I don’t have the time. It’s bizarre. Please please work towards creating a more efficient app and website, with quick processing of inputs. Also, a huge tip - please add the “wish list” shortcut to the items on their thumbnails itself in the app and the website. Half the times on the web, even after you open the product page it only shows “add to bag” option. It’s bizarre.
